support_selection.rule: validation-error greedy: locate the validation state with the largest scaled potential-plus-gradient error and append the nearest unused candidate state
support_selection.support_count_selection_rule: smallest evaluated support count for which each branch's independent-validation objective is within 10% of that branch's minimum over the evaluated counts

reference_state.convention: Sensible ideal-gas enthalpy and entropy are zero at T_ref; formation enthalpies are not included.

CH4.source: Setzmann and Wagner, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 20, 1061-1151 (1991)

nC4.source: Buecker and Wagner, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 35, 929-1019 (2006)
